{{Quote|One of our officers just had an unfortunate dust-up with a valuable delegate and we need to&hellip; doctor the results.|Officer Breerdin|<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Body of Evidence|Balmorra}}</ref>}}
An '''officer''' in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], and during a quarrel with a [[Unidentified Chiss delegate|Chiss delegate]] in the [[Sunken Sarlacc cantina]], the [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] the delegate. In order to preserve the Imperial-[[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] alliance, Officer [[Breerdin]] arranged for the security recording to be doctored and frame the [[Balmorran resistance]] for the delegate's murder.
